g.text: VACUUM BATCH DISTILLATION VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
VACUUM BATCH DISTILLATION C-101 · METHYL PALMITATE CAMPAIGN
1. Flags: simulator model, noise off. Start of campaign at total reflux, except 9 (off-cut, 120 min) and 10 (product cut, 547 min).
2. Flows kg/h (water m3/h); temperatures °C; pressures mbar abs. Sizes indicative.
3. Batch charge 110 L (95.7 kg) FAME; residue stays in D-101 until discharged.
